contentText: Most women around the world have a time in their lives where they think a lot about pregnancy: either how not to become pregnant, or perhaps how to do so. But around one in six people have experienced infertility at some point in their lives. That's the case of author and journalist Line Rifai, who tells us about her struggle to fall pregnant in her 30s. She has written a book in French entitled "Ménopause (très) précoce" or '"A very early menopause."
